summary.text: PROSESS PARTNER AS is a private limited company registered in Bergen, founded 2003-10-21. PROSESS PARTNER AS provides consulting related to business advisory with a particular focus on strategy and efficiency processes (organisational development). Its main industry code is 70.200: business and other management consultancy activities. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 7 685 065 NOK and the annual result was 5 264 375 NOK; operating income was up from 4 976 986 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 935 099 NOK in 2024 to 5 264 375 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 2 699 033 NOK in 2024 to 7 963 408 NOK in 2025. Recent changes in the register: email set to post@inventura.no on 2026-02-24.
